text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Cheval Grand seemingly had somewhere
she wanted to drop by, so I decided to go along with her.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's quite a long walk...
I'm sorry for making you come along...
choice_data_list: It's okay. Where are you headed?
It's okay. Where are you going?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, well...
The hat's...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
What should I do about the hat...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~? It's Tarumae!
What's with that grumpy look on your face?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Actually, I got a haskap stain
on my usual hat...
and it just won't come out...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a coincidence...!
Actually, I washed my usual hat too, and
its shape got all messed up~.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No way... Even those two in hats...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually, the rose on Rice's Hat-san has been wearing down too...
Rice wonders if there's anything Rice can do for it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ! Ah, no, um, well...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, you guys having hat troubles too?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wah! CB-san, what happened!?
Your hat is completely soaked~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
S-Soaking wet...!?
No way...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—!
Ah... um, well... m-my hat is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Cheval Grand's gaze, I see
Mr. C.B. and the others in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... I overheard that
someone was having trouble with their hat...?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I-I know a dry cleaner that specializes in hats.
I was just thinking of heading there right now, but..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: Do you want to invite everyone?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—M-My hat is...
something very precious to me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It protects me... and hides my weak self.
It's like a partner that's been
with me all this time, you know...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I know everyone's hat is precious to them...
so I thought it'd be best to clean them up..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If there's a way to get a precious hat cleaned,
anyone would want to use it.
Just like Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Just like... me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—U-Understood.
I will... try inviting them...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A-A-U-Umm!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "W-Won't you come with me to the hat cleaner's!?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
H-Here,
they can handle repairs, stain removal, and dry cleaning...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Incredible...! With this, everyone's hats will be nice and clean...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Cheval-san, thank you for telling me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N-No, um... yes...
choice_data_list: I'm glad everyone was so pleased.
Do you have any recommended courses?
Do you have any recommended courses?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N-No, um... yes...
choice_data_list: I'm glad everyone was so pleased.
Do you have any recommended courses?
Do you have any recommended courses?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Chevalier-chan, what's wrong!?
Are you okay? Does something hurt!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N-No... M-My legs... gave out...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Cheval Grand had summoned every ounce of courage she had to invite everyone. I decided to make sure to praise her hard work properly later.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... There are various options,
like UV protection and water-repellent coating...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, sounds good. Then I guess I'll go with Cheval's recommended course.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What other options do we have?
I'd love to hear more about them!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Hyah! Um, uhhh~~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I gave her timely support as she flustered over everyone asking her for advice, watching over their heartwarming interaction.
